scope: Production GitHub Pages verification for the approved short flower anchor, Wuji official-model comparison, and repository QR
summary: GitHub Pages run 31851848517 deployed commit 89ee18f83d7f6806ae2bd50bf27123b5022a756f successfully; production media hashes, browser decode/playback, responsive layout, QR decode, and long-flower removal all pass.
evidence: GitHub Actions workflow run 31851848517 completed successfully in 21 seconds with checkout, Pages configuration, site preparation, artifact upload, and deployment all passing.
The production 3.708333-second flower video is H.264 896x512 at 24 FPS, decodes to 89 frames, and matches SHA-256 2afd1238a976b3b87b10ebbcbccb83ac3d5e3ca630af184738bb8bb2df00f255.
The production 20.7-second Wuji comparison is H.264 2560x768 at 30 FPS, decodes to 621 frames, and matches SHA-256 742aea8554d49fcd55967e18b1ad20af2ef4f51bb6957077a8786f6e7c441ab2.
The Wuji render is 34.7399 FPS; the measured detect, retarget, render, encode, and decode path takes 30.5977 seconds at 20.2956 effective FPS.

In Edge, both production videos reach HTMLMediaElement readyState 4 with no media error and exact durations/resolutions; the short clip autoplays and the Wuji clip advances after an explicit play action.

The production QR matches SHA-256 c92cde3fc4607c5ffc7d054ec2948d9a92a710d8fe178bcac77169c4053cfc71 and independently decodes to https://github.com/YuhuaJiang2002/PhiAgent at native 720 pixels and displayed 270 pixels.
The responsive audit at a 375-pixel content viewport has no horizontal overflow; the QR remains 270x270 pixels and the card stacks to one column.
The prior 27.5-second flower title is absent and its former production asset URL returns HTTP 404.
lessons: A Pages release is not concluded by workflow success alone; production bytes, browser media state, playback progression, and QR behavior must be independently verified.

The earlier failed Pages run 31819491727 ended before runner allocation with zero steps, so it was not a media upload or codec failure; a later same-revision deployment succeeded after the Pages environment branch policy was corrected.
A lazy-loaded QR can appear blank in a full-page capture until scrolled into view; acceptance must inspect the actual viewport after intersection, natural dimensions, and decoded target.
limitations: The flower demo is intentionally the previously accepted 3.708333-second visual anchor, not evidence that the 27.5-second long-video problem is solved.
The Wuji comparison remains an official-model simulation rather than footage or telemetry from physical Wuji hardware.
The Pages workflow still reports a non-blocking GitHub Actions annotation that Node.js 20 actions are being forced to Node.js 24.
next_actions: Keep the production page pinned to the accepted short anchor until a long-video challenger passes the unchanged adversarial gates.
Upgrade GitHub Actions revisions when their maintainers publish native Node.js 24 releases.
